profile.name: Zeeshan Siddiqui
profile.title: Full Stack Developer (MERN)
profile.summary: I build full-stack web apps that people actually use. From REST APIs and auth to clean React interfaces, I like owning a feature end to end. Right now I'm shipping features on a live SaaS platform with the MERN stack, and I'm looking for my next role.

projects.title: Store Rating Application
projects.description: Full-stack multi-role store rating platform for Admin, Normal User, and Store Owner roles.
bullets: Built a full-stack multi-role store rating platform implementing JWT-based authentication, role-based authorization (RBAC), and bcrypt password hashing to secure access for Admin, Normal User, and Store Owner roles.
Designed a normalized MySQL schema with foreign keys, ENUM types, and a composite unique constraint on ratings to enforce one rating per user per store at the database level.
Implemented Sequelize ORM with model associations (hasMany, belongsTo), lifecycle hooks for automatic password hashing, and aggregate queries (AVG, COUNT) for real-time store ratings.
Built a dynamic admin dashboard with filterable/sortable user and store management, and a store owner dashboard displaying per-store average ratings and rater details.

projects.title: Renting Places – Airbnb-style Rental Platform
projects.description: Full-stack rental listing platform built with MVC architecture.
bullets: Built a full-stack rental listing platform with MVC architecture, featuring user authentication, listing CRUD, and reviews.
Integrated Cloudinary for image management, Mapbox for interactive property maps, and Joi for server-side form validation.
Implemented robust error handling via wrapAsync and ExpressError middleware, and session-based auth with Passport.js.

projects.title: FinVerse – Full-Stack Trading Web Application
projects.description: Trading web application built as three independent modules: Dashboard, Frontend, and Backend.
bullets: Architected a three-module system (Dashboard, Frontend, Backend) for clean separation of concerns and independent scalability.
Implemented secure authentication and authorization using JWT with cookie-based session handling and bcrypt password hashing.
Integrated Axios for API communication, React Router for SPA navigation, and React Toastify for real-time user feedback.
Applied CORS configuration, environment variable management, and secure cookie handling to meet production security standards.
Developed and maintained a production SaaS biometric and interview platform using React.js, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, supporting real-time data processing and multi-user access.
Architected and implemented secure REST APIs with JWT-based authentication and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), protecting data for 500+ user accounts.
Built responsive, cross-device UI components using React.js and Tailwind CSS, reducing load time and improving user engagement.
Integrated TanStack Query and Redux Toolkit for efficient server-state management and client-side caching, minimizing API calls.
Collaborated in a 4-member Agile team, participating in code reviews and daily standups to ensure timely feature delivery.
Implemented secure API integrations with third-party services and followed best practices for environment variable management and CORS configuration.
